chunks: 2260 - And al-Baqir Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said:

"Whoever resides in Makkah for a year, Allah will forgive his sin, and the sins of his household, and of everyone for whom he sought forgiveness, and of his clan, and of his neighbors—the sins of nine years that have already passed; and they will be protected from every evil for one hundred and forty years."

key_terms.جَاوَرَ: resided in proximity, especially in Makkah as a neighboring resident
key_terms.غَفَرَ: forgave and covered sins by divine mercy
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Makkah, the sacred city and site of pilgrimage

ai.seo_question: What are the virtues of residing in Makkah for one year according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the immense merit of residing in Makkah for a year. It presents Allah’s forgiveness and protection as extending not only to the person, but also to members of his household, relatives, neighbors, and those for whom he seeks forgiveness.
